title: 跨时区团队怎样约定普通消息和时效更新
topic: 跨时区团队怎样约定普通消息和时效更新

source.context: 来源为 Atlassian Team Communication Norms Play。练习引导团队讨论消息发送时间、回复期待、时效信息可见性、记录和复查。原文明确说明值班轮换不属于本练习；本课不为值班或紧急事故另造公司政策。课程中的示例渠道和规则均是标注过的模拟团队约定。
paragraphs: Collaborating with people who have different communication styles and across time zones can be tricky. Make it easier by agreeing on team communication norms.
First, explore why some team members may be feeling like they can’t unplug after working hours. If you aren’t using the Confluence whiteboard template, write these three questions on the board:

Give the team 10 minutes to answer these questions using “Yes” or “No” stickers for a digital whiteboard or green and red markers for physical whiteboards. The responses will determine which kind of communication norms would be most helpful for the team:
Divide each exercise into two sections: * Brainwriting (3 mins): Ask team members to add their responses to the prompts on sticky notes. (One response or idea per sticky note.)

2. Discussion and commitment (7 mins): Discuss the responses as a team, and decide on your process and communication norms. Capture those decisions on sticky notes in the section called “Our team communication norms.”
How quickly should teammates reply to messages outside of their core working hours?
How can we flag time-sensitive info so it gets noticed?
What’s the best way to mark communications as critical or urgent?
Where should we post important updates so people see them as soon as they log in?
Any other team communication norms that come up during the conversation
Capture what your team agreed on so the norms aren’t forgotten when the meeting ends.
Document the decisions in your team’s shared workspace, such as a Confluence page or a Slack channel.
Set a recurring, quarterly check-in to reflect on what’s working and what needs adjusting.
translations: 与沟通风格不同的人合作、跨时区协作可能不容易；共同约定团队沟通规范能让协作更顺畅。
先了解为什么有些成员觉得下班后无法离线。若不用 Atlassian 白板模板，可在白板上讨论以下问题：
让团队用“是/否”回答。大家的反馈将决定哪些沟通规范最有帮助。
脑写环节（3 分钟）：请成员把对提示问题的想法写在便利贴上，每张写一个想法。
讨论和承诺（7 分钟）：团队讨论并决定沟通流程和规范，把决定记录到“我们的团队沟通规范”区域。
团队成员在核心工作时间以外收到消息后，应多快回复？
如何标记有时效要求的信息，让它受到注意？
怎样标记关键或紧急沟通最合适？
重要更新应发到哪里，才能让成员登录时看到？
也把讨论中出现的其他团队沟通约定纳入规范。
记录团队达成的约定，避免会议结束后被遗忘。
把决定记在团队共享工作区，例如 Confluence 页面或 Slack 频道。
设定每季度一次的固定回顾，检查哪些做法有效、哪些需要调整。
fullTextParagraphs: Collaborating with people who have different communication styles and across time zones can be tricky. Make it easier by agreeing on team communication norms.
A note about on-call teammates: On-call rotations are a special case. Since they require availability outside of core working hours, they’re considered out of scope for this exercise.
First, explore why some team members may be feeling like they can’t unplug after working hours. If you aren’t using the Confluence whiteboard template, write these three questions on the board:
When you get messages outside your working hours, do you feel like you have to respond right away?
After your workday ends, do you worry important decisions might happen without your input?
Do you ever feel like not responding during core hours might make you seem less committed?

Give the team 10 minutes to answer these questions using “Yes” or “No” stickers for a digital whiteboard or green and red markers for physical whiteboards. The responses will determine which kind of communication norms would be most helpful for the team:
Divide each exercise into two sections: * Brainwriting (3 mins): Ask team members to add their responses to the prompts on sticky notes. (One response or idea per sticky note.)

2. Discussion and commitment (7 mins): Discuss the responses as a team, and decide on your process and communication norms. Capture those decisions on sticky notes in the section called “Our team communication norms.”
How quickly should teammates reply to messages outside of their core working hours?
How can we gather input from everyone?
How can everyone weigh in on important discussions, no matter their time zone?
How can we flag time-sensitive info so it gets noticed?
What’s the best way to mark communications as critical or urgent?
Where should we post important updates so people see them as soon as they log in?
As the team goes through each of the exercises, add decisions from each topic to the appropriate section below to create norms about:
When will team communications be sent
When we expect people to read and respond to messages
How we gather input from everyone
How we share time-sensitive information
Any other team communication norms that come up during the conversation
Capture what your team agreed on so the norms aren’t forgotten when the meeting ends.
Document the decisions in your team’s shared workspace, such as a Confluence page or a Slack channel.
Make it easy to find by pinning the Slack message or bookmarking the page in your team’s chat channel.
Set a recurring, quarterly check-in to reflect on what’s working and what needs adjusting.

notes.explain: 发送和回复时间要考虑接收者的当地工作时间，避免把延迟回复自动解释为不投入。
notes.example: Our project team works across time zones.

notes.phrase: out of scope for this exercise
notes.meaning: 不属于这项练习的范围
notes.explain: Atlassian 明确把值班轮换排除在沟通规范活动之外；团队既有值班政策应单独遵循。
notes.example: On-call rotations are out of scope for this exercise.

notes.phrase: outside of their core working hours
notes.meaning: 在他们的核心工作时间之外
notes.explain: 这是团队要讨论的回复期待问题；原文没有规定每个团队都必须立刻回复或一律等到次日。
notes.example: How quickly should teammates reply outside of their core working hours?

notes.explain: 团队应约定如何标记这类信息以及发在哪里容易被看到；来源并没有为值班或事故处理另定渠道。
notes.example: How can we flag time-sensitive info so it gets noticed?

scenario.title: Agreeing on message timing across Shanghai and London
english: The project team works in Shanghai and London.
A routine message sometimes arrives near midnight in the recipient’s local time, and deadline-sensitive updates are hard to spot.
At a team discussion, you propose response expectations for routine messages, a visible way to flag time-sensitive updates, and a quarterly review of the written norms.
chinese: 项目团队成员分布在上海和伦敦。
普通消息有时会在接收者当地接近午夜时到达，有截止时间的更新也不容易被看到。
团队讨论时，你建议约定普通消息的回复预期、明显标记有时效要求的更新，并按季度复查书面规则。

firstAttempt.prompt: 模拟情境：团队成员分布在上海和伦敦。请用英文提出普通消息的回复预期、时效更新的可见方式，并说明将规则记录在哪里、何时复查。
firstAttempt.sample: Could we agree that routine messages do not need an after-hours reply? For time-sensitive updates, let’s use the shared project channel and state the deadline clearly. We can document the norms in our shared workspace and revisit them at our quarterly check-in.
firstAttempt.rationale: 把普通消息回复预期、时效信息标记、记录位置和定期复查分开说清楚；示例规则是模拟提议，不是 Atlassian 对所有团队的统一规定。

words.example: Our communication norms explain when replies are expected.
words.translation: 我们的沟通规范说明大家预期何时回复。
words.note: norms 是团队共同约定的行为方式，不是单方面规定。

words.collocation: during core working hours; outside core working hours
words.example: The team discussed messages sent outside core working hours.
words.translation: 团队讨论了核心工作时间以外发送的消息。
words.note: 它不等同于所有人的同一班次，跨时区团队需说明本地时间。

words.meaning: 先写下想法再讨论的集思方式
words.example: We used three-minute brainwriting before discussing the response rules.
words.translation: 讨论回复规则前，我们先用三分钟写下想法。
words.note: Atlassian 的练习先个人写想法，再团队讨论承诺。

words.meaning: 可见性；容易被看到的程度
words.example: Posting the deadline in the shared channel improves visibility.
words.translation: 在共享频道里写清截止时间能提高信息可见性。
words.note: 在团队协作中，信息不只是存在，还要让相关人容易找到。

words.example: Mark a time-sensitive update with its deadline.
words.translation: 给有时效要求的更新标出截止时间。
words.note: 说明信息的时间要求，避免所有消息都被误当成紧急。

words.example: We review the communication norms quarterly.
words.translation: 我们每季度复查沟通规范。
words.note: quarterly 指每三个月一次；来源建议固定季度回顾。

structure.original: How quickly should teammates reply to messages outside of their core working hours?
analysis: “How quickly”询问回复速度，不能据此推断团队必须立即答复。
“should teammates reply”用 should 讨论团队期望；在此处是要共同商定的问题，不是既定规则。
“outside of their core working hours”限定消息到达时间，需结合跨时区成员的工作时间约定理解。
structure.transfer: How quickly should the support team reply to non-urgent questions outside local working hours?

rewrite.bad: Everyone has to answer every message immediately, even after work.
rewrite.good: For routine messages, let’s agree on a reasonable reply window across local work hours. For time-sensitive updates, use the shared project channel and state the deadline. We’ll document the norm and review it quarterly.
rewrite.translation: 普通消息方面，我们约定一个兼顾各地工作时间的合理回复窗口；时效更新发到共享项目频道并写清截止时间。我们会记录规则并按季度复查。
rewrite.pattern: For [routine messages], agree on [reply expectation]. For [time-sensitive updates], use [visible channel] and state [deadline].

cloze.prompt: The Atlassian exercise asks how quickly teammates should reply outside core working ___.
cloze.why: 原文明确讨论核心工作时间以外收到消息后应多快回复。

cloze.prompt: After three minutes of brainwriting, spend seven minutes on discussion and ___.
cloze.why: 原文把第二步称为 discussion and commitment。

cloze.prompt: Set a recurring, ___ check-in to review the norms.
cloze.why: Atlassian 建议每季度回顾哪些做法有效、哪些需要调整。

dictation.text: Make it easier by agreeing on team communication norms.
How quickly should teammates reply to messages outside of their core working hours?

translationPractice.prompt: 让我们共同约定跨时区团队的沟通规范。
translationPractice.answer: Let’s agree on team communication norms across our time zones.
translationPractice.why: 团队共同商定规范，而不是默认所有人采用同一时段。

translationPractice.prompt: 团队成员在核心工作时间以外收到消息后，应多快回复？
translationPractice.answer: How quickly should teammates reply to messages outside of their core working hours?
translationPractice.why: 这是来源中的讨论问题，不暗示答案必然是立刻回复。

translationPractice.prompt: 让我们把约定记录在团队共享空间，并按季度复查。
translationPractice.answer: Let’s document the decisions in our shared workspace and review them quarterly.
translationPractice.why: 记录约定并按季度检查是否有效。

choice.prompt: Atlassian 的 Team Communication Norms Play 建议怎样形成团队规则？
options: 主持人直接宣布规定，成员无需讨论。
成员先用 3 分钟写下想法，再用 7 分钟讨论并承诺团队采用的规则。
把所有消息设为紧急，并要求立即回复。
choice.why: 来源步骤是 brainwriting 3 分钟，再 discussion and commitment 7 分钟。

output.prompt: 模拟迁移：纽约和新加坡的发布团队经常在私聊里发普通状态更新，有截止时间的消息也不容易被看到。请用英文建议普通消息的回复预期、时效更新的发布位置和标注方式，并提出记录规则及季度复查。
output.sample: Let’s agree that routine status messages can wait until the recipient’s local working hours. For time-sensitive updates, post in the shared release channel and state the deadline clearly. We’ll document these norms in our shared workspace and review them quarterly.
check: 是否区分普通消息和有时效要求的更新？
是否考虑接收者所在时区的工作时间？
是否为时效信息指定可见位置并写明截止时间？
是否安排记录规则和季度复查？
